latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Voiceover for Video — Generate and Add Video Narration:

- Add AI-generated voiceover narration to your MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos (up to 500MB).
- Supports uploads, edits, and exporting to 1080p MP4 with natural-sounding narration in English.
- Workflow: Upload video → generate/edit narration via cloud backend → 30–90s processing → download ready-to-share video.
- Handles credits, session management, and real-time status updates; guides users with clear chat prompts.
- Built-in error handling for token expiration, missing credits, unsupported files, and more.
- Designed for creators, marketers, and educators to quickly add professional narration without installing local software.
